LESSON: GUIDED WRITING: DESCRIPTIVE WRITING

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ARABIC
Strand: Writing 3.2 Guided Writing: Neatness and Legibility (2 Sessions) • Handwriting •
Topic 3.4: Guided Writing: Descriptive Writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Writing: Descriptive Writing, part of Writing 3.2 Guided Writing: Neatness and Legibility (2 Sessions) • Handwriting • in Grade 8 ARABIC.

Key inquiry question: How can you manage your time well? 2. Why do we organise ideas in a paragraph?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. write sentences from various clock faces to tell time in relation to school events, in groups,

2. prepare a mind map displaying events in school or home that happen at different times,

3. share the mind maps with peers for review,

4. collaborate with peers to organise the ideas in a logical sequence and occurence,

5. write a coherent paragraph describing events using the sequenced ideas,

6. collaborate with peers to compete in rearranging jumbled up parts of a paragraph to make a meaningful text on telling time. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. write sentences from various clock faces to tell time in relation to school events, in groups,
2. prepare a mind map displaying events in school or home that happen at different times,
3. share the mind maps with peers for review,
4. collaborate with peers to organise the ideas in a logical sequence and occurence,
5. write a coherent paragraph describing events using the sequenced ideas,
6. collaborate with peers to compete in rearranging jumbled up parts of a paragraph to make a meaningful text on telling time. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Writing: Descriptive Writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to learn: This is promoted as the learner builds on their own learning experiences by sharing the mind maps with

peers for review.

• Creativity and Imagination: These are promoted as the learner exchanges new ideas that inspire creativity when preparing a

mind map displaying events in school or at home, that happen at different times.

Values:
Unity: This is enhanced as the learner collaborates with peers to organise the ideas in a logical sequence and occurrence.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Self management: This is promoted as the learner practices time management skills when talking about telling time.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner is able to relate the concept of paragraph writing to their learning of similar concepts in English.
